caption: Climate-response magnitude and direction agreement. (a) SSP1–2.6; (b) SSP2–4.5; (c) SSP5–8.5: equal three-model mean change in normalized affected-tissue duration by 2071–2100 relative to 1991–2020 on valid historical–future paired seasons. (d) Agreement on an increase, decrease or mixed/zero signs under SSP5–8.5; fewer than three model estimates are unavailable. All panels retain 14,941 native cell footprints, EPSG3035 and identical extent. Values describe the wheat component of each mixed-land-use cell. The continuous colour scale is shared by (a)–(c); triangular ends retain values beyond ±12 days. Agreement among selected models is not a probability or independent verification. The output is a normalized symptom-tissue proxy, not measured physiological loss or grain loss. Natural Earth outlines do not enter the model. Map lines delineate study areas and do not necessarily depict accepted national boundaries.
